style: Prooflane industrial editorial: quiet Proof-Paper field, technical hairlines and registration marks, Signal-Teal only for the rising three-bar mark. Precise, weighted, and restrained rather than playful.

customize.source: The installed spring-pop component is a motion reference only. Apply its explicit from-to overshoot/settle grammar to the existing Prooflane three-bar mark rather than adding a badge.
customize.logo: Inline reproduction of the existing Brand component in ../../src/app/page.tsx: three 5px teal bars, increasing 9/16/22px heights, a -10deg skew, and the wordmark 'prooflane'.
customize.motion: Three bars rise in visual left-to-right order from their shared baseline with individually controlled scaleY and a 1-2% settle. A technical baseline draws beneath them, then the wordmark arrives from the right with a short opacity/translation reveal.

layout.lockup: centered slightly above vertical middle; symbol at x=698 and wordmark begins x=850
layout.baseline: wide hairline from x=510 to x=1410 at y=646
layout.registration_marks: four low-opacity corner ticks set well outside the lockup

motion_plan.action: Paper field and faint technical guides fade to their settled opacity.
Bar 1 rises from scaleY 0.08 to 1 with a tightly damped 1% overshoot; opacity reaches 1 independently.
Bar 2 repeats with 0.16s offset and slightly more upward travel.
Bar 3 repeats with 0.16s offset, completing the ascending mark.
Teal baseline draws left-to-right under the mark and resolves to a fine structural line.
Wordmark enters from x=-30 and opacity 0, easing to its exact final position while the symbol makes one final 1% settle.
Full lockup holds static for legibility; only the already-visible fine framework remains as a quiet finished composition.
